description: Companion to training-run/valid-envelope-energy.json. The v0.23 energy-bearing shape of presidio-hardened/training-run@1: the OPTIONAL energy_wh / mean_power_w fields (producer claims under the v0.18 trust boundary, PRESIDIO-REQ Energy Arc E1a) added to the training-run/valid-envelope payload and nothing else. Additive & conditional (ADR-0011): a record WITHOUT them re-hashes byte-identically to training-run/valid-envelope — absent fields never perturb the canonical bytes — so `no_energy_content_hash` here equals that vector's hash. energy_wh / mean_power_w are shortest-round-trip decimal STRINGS, never floats (ADR-0001 D1), and physically coherent with duration_s (7200 s == 2 h at 420 W == 840 Wh). Byte-for-byte cross-checked against arch-translucency test_training.py::test_training_run_energy_bearing_self_pin (content hash d674a115…): pat swaps its local self-pin for THIS family vector (L-EV-7).
